lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively dense in the anterior torso and increases in width across the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 6, 7, and 8 from the anterior exhibit significant fragmentation, terminating in the mid-lower torso as discrete spot-like segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior flank and the region of the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is observed at the ventral termination point of the mid-torso line segments.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white sub-ocular spots, white facial markings on the bridge of the nose, and a prominent white patch on the lower neck/throat region.
